item.title: Reimagining the business of medicine: Navigating transformational technology, consolidation, workforce transition, and physician leadership
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how transformational technologies, industry consolidation, and workforce changes are reshaping healthcare delivery and business models. The collection seeks to understand how these converging forces impact the organization and management of medical services.

Appel publié par Business Horizons. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Transformational technology in healthcare
  • Healthcare consolidation
  • Workforce transition in medicine
  • Physician leadership

item.title: Corporate duty of care and liability in the age of advanced AI: Legal risk, accountability, and corporate exposure
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the evolving legal responsibilities and accountability frameworks that organizations must navigate as artificial intelligence technologies become increasingly sophisticated and integrated into business operations. The focus is on understanding corporate duty of care obligations, liability exposures, and the regulatory landscape that governs AI use in corporate settings.
